title: Earthquake Response
description: Explains what to do during shaking indoors, outdoors, driving, or near the coast, then the immediate safety checks afterward, including gas leaks and signs of structural damage. Covers aftershocks, the first hours and days of recovery, water and food safety, and preparing your home.
shortDescription: Drop, cover, hold on, then check for gas, damage, and aftershocks
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
